govdocs-archive_org-nsia-GonzalezManuelG: This City of Miami inter-office memorandum on the suspect in the president’s case is a police file. Miami cops tracked the threat. The memo may hold a clue. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of the record.
the-queen-pedauque: Anatole France's delightful novel follows Jacques Ménétrier, a young cook's boy in eighteenth-century Paris who falls in with a learned, skeptical abbé. Together they chase the secrets of alchemy through taverns and salons, meeting rogues and philosophers. Witty, erudite, and gently mocking, it is France at his most entertaining.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-afonzo-de-alb: This 1913 reference article on Afonso de Albuquerque — the Portuguese viceroy who built an eastern empire. Adolph Bandelier tells his conquests. Goa, Malacca, and Ormuz fell to him. The lion of the Indian seas. Portugal's greatest sea lord. His captains mapped the spice islands.
